title: Managed identity and Key Vault
summary: Remove long-lived application secrets where platform identity can authenticate directly.

blocks.text: Remove long-lived application secrets where platform identity can authenticate directly.

items: A managed identity is an Azure-managed service principal associated with a resource.
Grant only the required role/secret permissions.
Key Vault centralizes secrets/keys/certificates when a secret is unavoidable.
Log access and rotate credentials without changing application source where possible.
